t: You're standing at the Hamilton Memorial Drinking Fountain, a public drinking fountain that commemorates Sir James Hamilton, second Baronet, of Woodbrook. He lived from 1802 to 1876 and was a British politician. The material I have on him is brief, so that is all I can say with confidence about the man behind the memorial. It is a small reminder of how Victorian Londoners marked a person's name with something useful for passers-by.
